DLR Group is an integrated design firm with a promise to elevate the human experience through design. This fuels the work we do around the world and inspires our mission to improve the lives of our clients, our communities, and our planet. If this sparks your interest, you’re in the right place.
DLR Group has an opening for an Interior Designer to support the growth of our Healthcare sector. We operate within a hybrid work model, supporting flexibility between office time and work from home.
About Healthcare at DLR Group
DLR Group is a nationally recognized integrated design practice with a rapidly expanding healthcare portfolio.

We are dedicated to our core mission to “Elevate the human experience through design.” Industry thought leaders guide our practice and work closely with our clients to ensure that design aspirations align with clinical needs, funding priorities, and the well-being of the communities served.

Our work draws on decades of experience working with top healthcare institutions nationwide, and our teams work collaboratively to deliver evidence-based, empathetic solutions regardless of project scale.

As an Interior Designer at DLR Group, you will play a versatile role in our Interiors team, with responsibilities that vary across projects. You will be involved in developing comprehensive material and finish palettes, creating 3D renderings, and preparing presentation drawings.

You'll also coordinate the design and technical development of interior aspects of projects, working closely with the integrated design team to deliver high-quality work that meets project scope, schedule, budget, and fee requirements.
In addition, you may assist the project manager with scheduling, developing work plans, creating cartoon sets, and ensuring QA/QC throughout the project. You'll often take the lead on interior design efforts, client interactions, and presentations. Our Interiors team is committed to upholding and promoting our company's core values in every aspect of their work. This role offers an opportunity to grow your skills and make a meaningful impact on a variety of projects.
If you are a collaborative thought leader with a strategic mindset this might be the position for you. DLR Group is 100% employee owned and as such you’ll enjoy the opportunity to have ownership in the Firm. We rely on all our employee-owners to apply their financial acumen to grow the Firm profitably.

Lead Interior Designer

by Ashley Buckley | Mar 14, 2024 | Job Opportunities, Uncategorized

The Lunz Group is seeking a self-motivated and detail-oriented individual that thrives in a creative and collaborative setting to join our team in Central Florida. Currently, we are in search of a Lead Interior Designer with 10+ years of experience. This person will be responsible for managing projects and leading the Interior Design department.

Employment Type: Full-time

Values you bring and Essential Responsibilities of Senior Interior Designer:

Manages projects and leads Interior Design department.
Participates in the design control of projects in the design development, construction documentation, and supervision phases.
Responsible for project budget management and cost control.
Liaises with Project Managers, Architects, and consultants to generate concepts for interiors projects.
Enhances the function, safety, and aesthetics of interior spaces.
Select samples, including flooring, carpet, and paint to be approved by client
Responsible for carrying out these design assignments requiring the development of new or improved techniques or design.
Understanding of interior design specifications, calculations, and industry standards.
Provides direction to lower-level interior design staff.
Cultivate and maintain strong client relationships.
Manages ambiguity and complex issues
Communicate effectively among team members and clients

Bachelor’s degree in interior design.
Certification as licensed professional required.
Over 10 years of experience.
Experience leading a team of lower-level designers.
Strong visualization and innovative design skills required.
Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, Bluebeam.
Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft Office required.

Beyond responsibilities and qualifications, it is fundamental that this candidate has the ability to collaborate, communicate and solve problems, as well as have a strong customer focus.

Built on six core values – Composition, Communication, Collaboration, Sustainability, Accountability and Resilience – The Lunz Group is a values driven, design-forward, client-centered firm. We believe in adding value to the built environment for our clients and our communities. We provide a high level of service and the solutions are consistent, well designed, and sustainable. We strive to be leaders in design innovation, solving for today’s realities while planning for tomorrow’s.

This intermediate-level position will be a member of our multi-disciplinary team and will collaborate with design and technical leadership and be an integral part of project teams. Under the direct supervision of designated project leadership the primary responsibilities will include the following:

Under the guidance of a Senior Interior Designer, lead the development of the project’s goals through all project phases (Programming Schematic Design, Design Development, Construction Documents, and Construction Administration).
Evaluate client needs; analyze and effectively document design objectives and spatial requirements with a focus on furniture planning and design.
Research, evaluate and coordinate furniture, fixtures and equipment (FFE) throughout all phases of interior design work, as required.
Coordinate design work, standards and code compliance within the team under limited direction from Senior Interior Designer. Coordinate with other disciplines, including architecture, engineering and consultants.
Responsible for development of the design of interior spaces with a focus on furniture design to include floor plans, pattern designs, elevations, details, room finishes etc.
Independently evaluate and select materials; consult with vendors.
Produce drawings in conformance with project time, budget and quality constraints.
Assist in project planning and follow through of work plans/budgeting.
Assist in and lead client meetings, as requested.
Mentor and supervise less experienced interior design staff.
Assist and/or lead “lessons learned” sessions.
Follow and maintain CannonDesign drawing standards.
Participate in construction administration activities, including site visits, review of submittals and shop drawings, and conducting punch list. Site visits frequently require a physical walk-through of site.
Actively participate in and promote design leadership within the practice.
Assist in marketing campaigns as requested.
Bachelor or Master's degree in Interior Design, Interior Architecture, or relevant field required.

s.h: Minimum of 6 years of related experience required.
s.t:
Relevant furniture planning, specification, and procurement experience strongly preferred.
A strong furniture/interior design portfolio demonstrating planning, specification, and implementation experience is preferred.

Must be design focused.
Must be an independent thinker.
Must be analytical.
Must possess a working knowledge and experience, while still acquiring higher level knowledge.
Strong creative design portfolio is essential as are strong communication, teamwork, presentation, graphics, organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects.
Proficiency with Revit, Enscape, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Suite required.
Travel as required.
